evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C08623 message: 'I never made this $49.00 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3530164.
Customer C08623 explicitly reported the flagged transaction 3530164 as unrecognized.
The flagged transaction was preceded 49 minutes earlier by transaction 3530056 by the same holder, which received a high model score of 0.622 (historical fraud rate 64.5%).
Card C08623-K2 has a severe history of compromise, with 5 prior confirmed fraud cases including CC-4957 and CC-3682.

case.summary: Customer C08623 explicitly reported a $49.00 in-person transaction as unrecognized. A review of the card's activity identified a preceding in-person transaction for $116.93 in the same region that received a high model score indicating a 64.5% historical fraud rate. Furthermore, the card has a severe history of compromise with five prior confirmed fraud cases. Given the direct customer report and the highly suspicious preceding transaction, the activity is confirmed as out-of-region fraud.
